## Intro

### intro-prologue

You are a young detective, standing in the bitter cold North Pole.

- [Continue](#intro-crossroads)

### intro-crossroads

You see smoke billowing from a workshop and wooden buildings in the distance. You can hear the faint sound of bells ringing and the smell of gingerbread in the air.

## Phone

### phone-call-santa

Your phone rings. And rings. Until you hear a jolly voice on the other end. *"Ho ho ho! Merry Christmas! Please leave a message after the bell."*

- [Sigh dramatically and hang up](#phone-sigh)
- [Stay on the line and listen after the bell](#phone-listen)

### phone-listen

You wait through the beep. Under the static you hear wind, a creaking door and the low clank of sleigh bells. Not workshop bells. Bigger. Heavier.

- [Hang up and think about it](#phone-think) *(sets: heardBells = true)*

### phone-think

You pocket the phone. Those were not workshop bells. They sounded like reindeer.

- [Follow the sound of the bells](#stables-arrive)
- [Head to the nearest elf](#elf-approach)
- [Look around you](#investigate-look-around)
- [Head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)

### phone-sigh

Frustrated, you try again, and again you hear: *"Ho ho ho! Merry Christmas! Please leave a message after the bell."*

- [Shake your head and smoke a cigarette](#phone-smoke-cigarette) *(requires: cigarettes · sets: cigarettes = false)*
- [Throw your phone into the snow in anger](#phone-throw-phone) *(requires: phone · sets: phone = false)*
- [Give up and put the phone away](#phone-give-up)

### phone-give-up

You put the phone away. Your shoulders sag as you realize that you are in over your head.

- [Head to the nearest elf](#elf-approach)
- [Look around you](#investigate-look-around)
- [Head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)

You take a long deep inhale.

- [Head to the nearest elf](#elf-approach)
- [Look around you](#investigate-look-around)

### phone-throw-phone

Your shoulders sag as you realize that you are in over your head.

### investigate-crit-fail-look

The wind howls around you, and the blizzard gives you little more than a wall of white. You can barely make out the workshop in the distance. A cold sense of dread settles in — you feel like you're missing something important.

- [Walk to the workshop](#workshop-approach) *(requires: hasCalledSanta)*

### investigate-fail-look

The wind howls around you, and the blizzard starts to pick up. You can barely make out the workshop or the elf village in the distance. Something about this place feels wrong, but you can't quite put your finger on it.

- [Try to call the workshop phone](#phone-call-santa) *(requires: !hasCalledSanta · sets: hasCalledSanta = true)*
- [Walk to the workshop](#workshop-approach) *(requires: hasCalledSanta)*
- [Head towards the elves](#elf-approach)
- [Look again [Roll D20]](#investigate-look-roll) *(requires: !lookedAgain · sets: lookedAgain = true)*

### investigate-success-look

You spot a set of fresh tracks disappearing into the snow. They are too small to be Santa's boots, but they seem to lead towards the stables.

- [Follow the tracks](#stables-arrive)
- [Ask the elves about the tracks](#elf-approach)
- [Head towards the workshop instead](#workshop-approach)

### investigate-crit-success-look

Something catches your eye beneath the snow. You brush it away and find a torn piece of red fabric, caught on a broken wooden fence post. It looks like it came from Santa's coat. Beside it are fresh footprints leading towards the stables.

- [Examine the fabric closely](#investigate-examine-fabric) *(sets: redFabric = true)*
- [Follow the footprints towards the stables](#stables-arrive) *(sets: redFabric = true)*
- [Take the fabric and head towards the workshop](#workshop-approach) *(sets: redFabric = true)*

### investigate-examine-fabric

Fine red wool, still faintly warm. Along the hem runs a stripe of blue frost that refuses to melt, even in your gloved hand.

- [Follow the footprints towards the stables](#stables-arrive) *(sets: frostClue = true)*
- [Ask the elves about the frost](#elf-approach) *(sets: frostClue = true)*
- [Take the fabric to the workshop](#workshop-approach) *(sets: frostClue = true)*

## Elf village: chat

### elf-approach

You walk towards a cluster of small wooden buildings. The smell of fresh hay and reindeer hangs in the air, mingling with smoke from a fire in an old metal drum. A handful of elves warm their hands. One catches your eye, grimaces, then turns away.

- [Warm your hands by the fire](#elf-warm-hands)
- [Ask about Santa](#elf-ask-about-santa-cold)
- [Threaten them](#elf-threaten)

### elf-warm-hands

You silently join the fire. All you can hear is the crackle of flames and the crunch of snow.

- [Wait](#elf-wait-by-fire)
- [Ask when they last saw Santa](#elf-ask-last-seen)

### elf-wait-by-fire

The other elves drift away, leaving you with the one who grimaced. In a gruff voice they say, *"I could do with a cigarette."*

- [Offer a cigarette](#elf-offer-cigarette) *(requires: cigarettes · sets: cigarettes = false, elfFriend = true)*
- [Say you don't have one](#elf-no-cigarette)

### elf-ask-last-seen

*"When did you last see Santa?"* The elf shrugs and stares into the fire. *"Ask me again when I've got something to smoke."*

- [Wait quietly](#elf-wait-by-fire)
- [Press harder](#elf-ask-about-santa-cold)

### elf-offer-cigarette

The elf takes a long drag and coughs. *"Thanks. I needed that."* He nods at the space beside him.

- [Ask about Santa](#elf-ask-about-santa)

### elf-no-cigarette

The elf grunts and goes back to watching the flames.

- [Ask about Santa anyway](#elf-ask-about-santa-cold)
- [Look around you](#investigate-look-around)
- [Head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)

### elf-ask-about-santa

*"So what do you know about Santa's disappearance?"* He takes another drag.

- [Listen](#elf-listen)

### elf-listen

A few minutes pass. The elf sighs. *"It's been a long festive period. Demand's at a record high, the big man's nowhere to be seen, and everyone's pretending it's fine."*

- [Ask about his family](#elf-ask-about-family)
- [Ask about the reindeer](#elf-ask-about-reindeer) *(sets: knowsHandlers = true)*
- [Ask about Jack Frost](#elf-ask-about-jack)
- [Ask how to get into the workshop](#elf-give-pass) *(requires: elfFriend · sets: hasPass = true)*

### elf-ask-about-family

*"Trouble at home. Arguments. Lots of them. That's all I'll say."* He flicks the butt into the snow.

- [Ask about the reindeer](#elf-ask-about-reindeer) *(sets: knowsHandlers = true)*
- [Ask about Jack Frost](#elf-ask-about-jack)
- [Ask how to get into the workshop](#elf-give-pass) *(requires: elfFriend · sets: hasPass = true)*

### elf-ask-about-reindeer

*"Speak to the reindeer handlers. Hollis and his lot. Jumpy all month, and the stables are off limits."* He turns back towards the workshop.

- [Head to the stables](#stables-arrive)
- [Ask about Jack Frost](#elf-ask-about-jack)
- [Ask how to get into the workshop](#elf-give-pass) *(requires: elfFriend · sets: hasPass = true)*
- [Head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)

### elf-ask-about-jack

*"Jack Frost? Used to be Vice Head Elf. Ran the second floor for two hundred years. They gave Head Elf to Evergreen instead, so Jack handed in his notice and said Christmas would be sorry."* He shivers. *"Funny. The fire never feels as warm when he's mentioned."*

- [Ask about the reindeer](#elf-ask-about-reindeer) *(sets: knowsHandlers = true)*
- [Ask how to get into the workshop](#elf-give-pass) *(requires: elfFriend · sets: hasPass = true)*
- [Head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)

### elf-give-pass

The elf rummages in his apron and hands you a crumpled lanyard. *"Visitor pass. Belonged to a cousin. He won't be needing it."*

- [Head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)
- [Head to the stables](#stables-arrive) *(requires: knowsHandlers)*
- [Ask about Jack Frost](#elf-ask-about-jack)

### elf-ask-about-santa-cold

You press for answers. The elf shrugs. *"I'm just a line elf. I make toys. I don't see nothin'."*

- [Threaten them](#elf-threaten)
- [Warm your hands and wait](#elf-warm-hands)
- [Walk away](#elf-leave)

### elf-threaten

You lean in. *"Tell me when you last saw Santa."* The elf stares back. *"Or what?"*

- [Throw a punch](#elf-throw-punch)
- [Ask why they are so desperate to avoid answering](#elf-intimidate)

### elf-intimidate

The elf's eyes flicker. *"...Fine. Ask your questions."* The gruffness has gone out of him, and so has the warmth.

- [Ask about Santa](#elf-ask-about-santa)

### elf-leave

You leave the fire behind. The elves watch you go.

- [Look around you](#investigate-look-around)
- [Head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)
- [Head to the stables](#stables-arrive) *(requires: knowsHandlers)*
- [Go back to the fire](#elf-warm-hands)

## Elf village: fight

### elf-throw-punch

You clench your fist and wind up. The elves around the fire go very quiet.

- [Swing [Roll D20]](#elf-punch-roll)

### elf-punch-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1: Critical fail](#elf-punch-crit-fail)
- [2-9: Fail](#elf-punch-fail)
- [10-19: Success](#elf-punch-success) *(sets: knowsHandlers = true)*
- [20: Critical success](#elf-punch-crit-success) *(sets: knowsHandlers = true, loftKey = true)*

### elf-punch-crit-fail

You slip on the ice and land flat on your back. The elves laugh. Somebody steals your hat.

- [Pick yourself up](#elf-leave)

### elf-punch-fail

You miss. The elf ducks and shoves you into a snowbank. *"Try that again and I'll bite."*

- [Apologise](#elf-apologise)
- [Walk away](#elf-leave)

### elf-apologise

The elf studies you. *"Reindeer handlers. Ask them. Now stay away from me."*

- [Head to the stables](#stables-arrive) *(sets: knowsHandlers = true)*
- [Walk away](#elf-leave) *(sets: knowsHandlers = true)*

### elf-punch-success

Your fist connects. The elf stumbles back, spitting tinsel. *"Alright! Ask the reindeer handlers! I know nothing else!"*

- [Head to the stables](#stables-arrive)
- [Head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)

### elf-punch-crit-success

You catch the elf square on the chin and he drops into the snow. A ring of keys falls from his apron, with a brass tag stamped LOFT. The other elves glare. *"Reindeer handlers,"* he groans. *"Take it and go."*

- [Take the keys and head to the stables](#stables-arrive)
- [Take the keys and head towards Santa's workshop](#workshop-approach)

## Workshop: entrance

### workshop-approach

You walk closer to the workshop. Warm light spills from the windows, and somewhere inside a hundred tiny hammers are tapping.

- [Walk up to the door and knock](#workshop-knock)
- [Walk in through the open door](#workshop-enter)
- [Show your workshop pass](#workshop-pass-entry) *(requires: hasPass)*
- [Slip round the back to the loading dock](#workshop-back-door)

### workshop-pass-entry

A bored security elf glances at your lanyard and waves you through.

- [Step inside](#floor-arrive)

### workshop-knock

An elf comes to the door, holding a clipboard and a cup of cocoa.

- [Introduce yourself](#workshop-introduce)
- [Ask about Santa](#workshop-ask-santa)

### workshop-introduce

You flash your badge. The elf squints. *"Interpol? We're a closed facility. Do you have an appointment?"*

- [Insist it is a missing person case [Roll D20]](#workshop-persuade-roll)
- [Ask about Santa](#workshop-ask-santa)

### workshop-ask-santa

*"Santa? He's on a flexible working arrangement. Management has asked us not to comment further."*

- [Show the torn red fabric](#workshop-show-fabric) *(requires: redFabric)*
- [Insist it is a missing person case [Roll D20]](#workshop-persuade-roll)
- [Go round the back](#workshop-back-door)

### workshop-show-fabric

The elf goes pale and glances over his shoulder. *"...Wait here."* He returns with a visitor lanyard and a very worried face.

- [Take the lanyard and go in](#floor-arrive) *(sets: hasPass = true)*

### workshop-persuade-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1: Critical fail](#workshop-turned-away) *(sets: alarmRaised = true)*
- [2-9: Fail](#workshop-turned-away)
- [10-19: Success](#workshop-let-in)
- [20: Critical success](#workshop-let-in-vip)

### workshop-turned-away

*"No appointment, no entry."* The door shuts in your face. Somewhere inside, a telephone starts ringing.

- [Go round the back](#workshop-back-door)
- [Head to the elf village](#elf-approach)
- [Look around you](#investigate-look-around)

### workshop-let-in

The elf sighs and steps aside. *"Fine. Wear this and don't touch anything."*

- [Take the lanyard and step inside](#floor-arrive) *(sets: hasPass = true)*

### workshop-let-in-vip

The elf stands straighter. *"Detective! We've been hoping someone would come."* He drops his voice. *"Cold Storage, the Frost Wing. They keep taking trays of food down there."*

- [Take the lanyard and step inside](#floor-arrive) *(sets: hasPass = true, knowsColdStore = true)*

### workshop-enter

You push through the open door. Warm air smells of gingerbread and machine oil. A security elf looks up. *"Oi! Where's your lanyard?"*

- [Show your workshop pass](#floor-arrive) *(requires: hasPass)*
- [Run past him [Roll D20]](#workshop-sneak-roll)
- [Apologise and step back outside](#workshop-approach)

### workshop-back-door

Round the back is a loading dock. One elf sits on a crate among wrapping paper offcuts, looking like he needs a break.

- [Offer him a cigarette](#workshop-dock-friend) *(requires: cigarettes · sets: cigarettes = false)*
- [Slip past while he sorts boxes [Roll D20]](#workshop-sneak-roll)
- [Go back round the front](#workshop-approach)

### workshop-dock-friend

*"Bless you."* He waves you through the staff door. *"Sorting hall's straight on. Avoid the Frost Wing, though. Acting Head Elf is... particular."*

- [Head inside](#floor-arrive) *(sets: knowsColdStore = true)*

### workshop-sneak-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1: Critical fail](#workshop-caught) *(sets: alarmRaised = true)*
- [2-9: Fail](#workshop-caught)
- [10-19: Success](#floor-arrive)
- [20: Critical success](#floor-arrive)

### workshop-caught

The security elf tackles you in a tinsel-themed rugby move. You are escorted outside by your collar.

## Workshop: toy floor

### floor-arrive

The toy floor hums: conveyor belts, hammers, a thousand elves assembling teddy bears. A banner reads *"ONE NIGHT TO MAKE THE YEAR"*. Everyone looks exhausted.

- [Check the production board](#floor-board) *(sets: frostClue = true)*
- [Talk to an elf on the line](#floor-talk-elf)
- [Listen at the conference room door](#floor-eavesdrop)
- [Go upstairs to Santa's office](#office-stairs)
- [Look for Mrs Claus in the kitchen](#mrs-claus-approach)
- [Look for Santa's son](#noel-approach)
- [Take the stairs down to Cold Storage](#jack-cold-store-door) *(requires: knowsColdStore)*
- [Head back outside](#intro-crossroads)

### floor-board

The production board is covered in red cancellation stamps. At the bottom is a memo: *"Efficiency Programme. All gifting projects under review. Signed, J. Frost, Acting Head Elf."*

- [Back to the toy floor](#floor-arrive)

### floor-talk-elf

A line elf named Tinsel keeps stapling without looking up. *"Production slowed the day Santa vanished. Jack Frost's acting head elf now. Keeps calling meetings about 'shareholder value'. Who are the shareholders? The children?"*

- [Ask where Jack goes](#floor-tinsel-jack) *(sets: knowsColdStore = true)*
- [Back to the toy floor](#floor-arrive)

### floor-tinsel-jack

*"Jack? He takes trays of cocoa down to Cold Storage three times a day. For a man who hates Christmas, he orders a lot of marshmallows."*

- [Go down to Cold Storage](#jack-cold-store-door)
- [Back to the toy floor](#floor-arrive)

### floor-eavesdrop

You press your ear to the conference room door. Two voices. *"You promised nothing would happen to him."* *"Nothing has. He's perfectly comfortable. Now, do you want the suit or not?"*

- [Stay and listen](#floor-eavesdrop-more) *(sets: overheardNoel = true)*
- [Back to the toy floor](#floor-arrive)

### floor-eavesdrop-more

You duck behind a stack of gift wrap as two figures leave: a young man in an oversized red suit, and a tall elf with ice-blue eyes who has never smiled at a deadline.

- [Follow the young man](#noel-approach)
- [Follow the tall elf](#jack-cold-store-door) *(sets: knowsColdStore = true)*
- [Back to the toy floor](#floor-arrive)

## Workshop: Santa's office

### office-stairs

You climb to Santa's office. The door hangs ajar and papers carpet the floor, as if someone left in a hurry.

- [Search the desk](#office-desk) *(sets: jackLetter = true)*
- [Check the computer](#office-computer)
- [Look out of the window](#office-window)
- [Go back downstairs](#floor-arrive)

### office-desk

In the top drawer is a half-written speech: *"After 1,700 deliveries, it is time to hang up the suit."* Underneath, a resignation letter in spiky handwriting: *"Effective immediately. You will regret passing me over. J. Frost."*

- [Try the locked bottom drawer [Roll D20]](#office-lock-roll)
- [Back to the office](#office-stairs)

### office-lock-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1: Critical fail](#office-alarm) *(sets: alarmRaised = true)*
- [2-9: Fail](#office-stuck)
- [10-19: Success](#office-keycard)
- [20: Critical success](#office-keycard)

### office-keycard

Inside the drawer lies a frost-white keycard stamped COLD STORAGE, beside a snow globe of the workshop that is slowly freezing from the inside.

- [Pocket the keycard](#office-stairs) *(sets: frostKey = true, knowsColdStore = true)*

### office-alarm

A siren whoops. Somewhere below, boots thunder. You bolt for the stairs, smiling politely at everyone you pass.

- [Lose yourself in the toy floor crowd](#floor-arrive)

### office-stuck

The lock stays stubbornly shut. You nearly snap your pick.

- [Back to the office](#office-stairs)

### office-computer

On Santa's screen is the sleigh manifest, stamped *"ROUTE CANCELLED. Authorised J. FROST."* Below it, an unsent email from someone called Noel: *"Dad, it's time. Step aside and let me take over. Please."*

- [Go and find Noel](#noel-approach) *(sets: noelMotive = true, frostClue = true)*
- [Back to the office](#office-stairs) *(sets: noelMotive = true, frostClue = true)*

### office-window

From the window you see the courtyard. A line of blue footprints crosses the snow towards a hatch marked COLD STORAGE. The frost around them is not melting.

- [Go to Cold Storage](#jack-cold-store-door) *(sets: knowsColdStore = true, frostClue = true)*
- [Back to the office](#office-stairs) *(sets: knowsColdStore = true, frostClue = true)*

## Workshop: Mrs Claus

### mrs-claus-approach

Mrs Claus kneads dough in the workshop kitchen, flour up to her elbows. Her hands are shaking.

- [Sit with her and let her talk](#mrs-claus-comfort)
- [Ask about the argument](#mrs-claus-argument)
- [Ask about Jack Frost](#mrs-claus-jack)
- [Leave her to it](#floor-arrive)

### mrs-claus-comfort

*"Thirty days,"* she whispers. *"He has never missed a single night in thirty days."* She presses a tin of gingerbread into your hands. *"Please. It helps me to give."*

- [Thank her and take the tin](#mrs-claus-talk) *(sets: hasGingerbread = true, mrsClausTrust = true)*

### mrs-claus-talk

She dabs her eyes with her apron. *"Ask me anything, dear."*

- [Ask about the argument](#mrs-claus-argument)
- [Ask about Jack Frost](#mrs-claus-jack)
- [Ask about the old Cold Storage](#mrs-claus-key) *(requires: mrsClausTrust)*
- [Leave her to it](#floor-arrive)

### mrs-claus-argument

*"Nicholas has promised Noel the suit for a century. A month ago he finally said yes. Then they argued about the date. The next morning he was gone."*

- [Ask about Jack Frost](#mrs-claus-jack)
- [Leave her to it](#floor-arrive)

### mrs-claus-jack

*"Jack? Vice Head Elf. When Nicholas chose Evergreen for Head Elf, Jack went very quiet. He still sends us a very cold card every Christmas."*

- [Ask about the argument](#mrs-claus-argument)
- [Ask about the old Cold Storage](#mrs-claus-key) *(requires: mrsClausTrust)*
- [Leave her to it](#floor-arrive)

### mrs-claus-key

*"The old larder in Cold Storage? Nicholas hated that room. Jack was always so fond of it."* She presses a small iron key into your palm. *"If you find my husband, tell him the oven is on."*

- [Take the key and leave](#floor-arrive) *(sets: frostKey = true, knowsColdStore = true)*

## Workshop: Noel

### noel-approach

In the wardrobe room a young man stands before a mirror in a red suit three sizes too big. The sleeves flap when he moves. He is rehearsing a speech.

- [Talk to him gently](#noel-talk)
- [Accuse him](#noel-accuse)
- [Leave him be](#floor-arrive)

### noel-talk

*"Everyone expects me to take over,"* he says. *"But how can I, when Dad's not even here?"*

- [Ask about the night Santa vanished](#noel-ask-santa)
- [Ask about Jack Frost](#noel-ask-jack)
- [Repeat what you know about him and Jack](#noel-ask-jack) *(requires: noelMotive || overheardNoel)*
- [Accuse him](#noel-accuse)

### noel-ask-santa

*"We argued. He said he wanted to retire, but kept moving the date. I said things I regret."* He tugs at the sleeves. *"That was the last time I saw him."*

- [Ask about Jack Frost](#noel-ask-jack)
- [Leave him be](#floor-arrive)

### noel-ask-jack

Noel goes very still. *"Jack's been... advising me. He said Dad would step aside gracefully if I just left them alone to talk."* A pause. *"I told him when Dad would be alone."*

- [Ask what he did](#noel-confess)
- [Back off](#noel-talk)

### noel-confess

*"I thought he only wanted to persuade him! I didn't know... Cold Storage. I gave him my keycard. Take it. Please. Bring Dad home."*

- [Take the keycard and promise to help him](#floor-arrive) *(sets: frostKey = true, noelAlly = true, knowsColdStore = true)*
- [Take the keycard and say he will face the consequences](#floor-arrive) *(sets: frostKey = true, knowsColdStore = true)*

### noel-accuse

*"What? No! I—"* He bolts out of the back door, shouting for Jack. The wardrobe door swings in the cold.

- [Chase after him](#jack-cold-store-door) *(sets: alarmRaised = true, knowsColdStore = true)*
- [Go back to the toy floor](#floor-arrive) *(sets: alarmRaised = true)*

## Workshop: Jack Frost

### jack-cold-store-door

A steel door marked COLD STORAGE: RESTRICTED. Frost creeps across the handle and your breath turns to smoke.

- [Use the key you found](#jack-cold-store-inside) *(requires: frostKey)*
- [Pick the lock [Roll D20]](#jack-lock-roll)
- [Turn back](#floor-arrive)

### jack-lock-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1: Critical fail](#jack-lock-alarm) *(sets: alarmRaised = true)*
- [2-9: Fail](#jack-lock-alarm) *(sets: alarmRaised = true)*
- [10-19: Success](#jack-lock-open)
- [20: Critical success](#jack-lock-open)

### jack-lock-alarm

The lock buzzes. The door swings open and two security elves in matching hi-vis grab your arms. *"Mr Frost will see you now."*

- [Go quietly](#jack-confront)

### jack-lock-open

The lock clicks. The door breathes out a cloud of cold and the faint smell of cocoa.

- [Step inside](#jack-cold-store-inside)

### jack-cold-store-inside

Frost coats the walls. Behind a glass partition sits Santa, wrapped in blankets beside a heater. Near him, at a desk, a tall elf with ice-blue eyes taps a spreadsheet titled *"Q4 STRATEGIC REDUCTION"*.

- [Step forward](#jack-confront)
- [Hide behind a crate and listen first](#jack-overhear)

### jack-overhear

Jack speaks into a phone. *"Midnight. Manifest cancelled, route wiped. Shareholders unhappy? Let them cry in Q1."* He hangs up and smiles at the heater.

- [Record him on your phone](#jack-confront) *(requires: phone · sets: hasRecording = true)*
- [Step forward](#jack-confront)

### jack-confront

*"Detective. Do come in. I'm mid-restructure, but I always have time for stakeholders."*

- [Let him talk](#jack-monologue)
- [Show him the evidence](#jack-shaken) *(requires: redFabric || jackLetter || hasRecording || frostClue)*
- [Offer Mrs Claus's gingerbread](#jack-gingerbread) *(requires: hasGingerbread)*
- [Catch him off guard [Roll D20]](#jack-fight-roll) *(requires: !alarmRaised)*
- [Hear his offer](#jack-offer)

### jack-monologue

*"Two hundred years as Vice Head Elf. Hit every target. Feedback: great experience at that level. Then they gave the job to Evergreen, who stacks boxes. Tonight at midnight, Christmas is cancelled. For restructuring."*

- [Show him the evidence](#jack-shaken) *(requires: redFabric || jackLetter || hasRecording || frostClue)*
- [Offer Mrs Claus's gingerbread](#jack-gingerbread) *(requires: hasGingerbread)*
- [Tackle him [Roll D20]](#jack-fight-roll)
- [Hear his offer](#jack-offer)

### jack-shaken

Jack flinches and the room cools a degree. *"That proves nothing. Anyone could—"* But his hand trembles, and his spreadsheet frosts over.

- [Press him](#jack-surrender)

### jack-gingerbread

You hold out the tin. Jack stares. *"Is that... Mrs Claus's? Spiced? With the little icing buttons?"* His voice cracks. *"She stopped baking for me when I left."*

- [Hand it over](#jack-surrender)

### jack-fight-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1: Critical fail](#jack-fight-lose)
- [2-9: Fail](#jack-fight-lose)
- [10-19: Success](#jack-fight-win)
- [20: Critical success](#jack-fight-win)

### jack-fight-lose

Jack flicks his fingers. A blast of ice pins your boots to the floor. *"Please, detective. I have a mortgage on this ice."*

- [Try to reason with him](#jack-monologue)
- [Hear his offer](#jack-offer)

### jack-fight-win

You tackle him into a stack of boxes labelled SURPLUS CHEER. His icy aura fizzles. *"Fine. Fine!"*

- [Pin him down](#jack-surrender)

### jack-offer

Jack straightens his tie. *"Here's a thought. Noel takes the suit. I finally become Head Elf. Santa stays comfortable in Cold Storage. You get your promotion. Everybody wins."* Behind the glass, Santa lifts his head weakly.

- [Accept the deal](#ending-hostile-takeover-sleigh)
- [Refuse and go for Santa [Roll D20]](#jack-fight-roll)
- [Refuse and keep him talking](#jack-monologue)

### jack-surrender

Jack slumps into his chair. The frost on the walls begins to thaw. *"I just wanted to be seen,"* he mutters.

- [Open the glass partition and free Santa](#jack-free-santa)

### jack-free-santa

Santa stumbles out, wrapped in blankets. *"Detective! I knew someone would come."* He looks at Jack, then at the thawing walls.

- [Escort Jack out and tell Santa everything](#ending-sleigh-launch)
- [Let Santa decide what to do with Jack](#jack-santa-decides)
- [Ask Santa to forgive Noel](#jack-noel-forgiven) *(requires: noelAlly)*

### jack-santa-decides

*"Jack, I overlooked you. That was wrong."* Santa pulls out a pen. *"Head of Operations. Four-day week."* Jack stares, then laughs for the first time in two centuries.

- [Watch them shake hands](#ending-sleigh-launch)

### jack-noel-forgiven

You tell Santa what Noel confessed. Santa closes his eyes. *"He's young. I was hard on him. We'll talk."* He doesn't look angry. Just tired.

- [Head out to the sleigh](#ending-sleigh-launch)

## Workshop: endings

### ending-sleigh-launch

At midnight the sleigh launches. Santa waves from the seat, Noel beside him in a suit that finally fits, Mrs Claus clutching an empty tin of gingerbread. Snow swirls, bells ring, and the sky fills with light.

- [Watch it disappear](#ending-the-vice-head-elf)

### ending-the-vice-head-elf

THE VICE HEAD ELF. Santa is safe, Christmas is saved, and Jack gets a corner office. Back at the station, they finally give you that promotion. Nobody believes the story, but you got the plaque.

- [Play again](#intro-prologue)

### ending-hostile-takeover-sleigh

You shake Jack's icy hand. At midnight Noel takes the reins in the red suit, jaw clenched, never once looking back at the glass door. The sleigh launches. Somewhere, children wake to presents.

- [Walk away](#ending-hostile-takeover)

### ending-hostile-takeover

HOSTILE TAKEOVER. Christmas is saved. Your promotion arrives on the 26th. Every year you hear sleigh bells in your sleep, and think of a man under blankets behind glass.

- [Play again](#intro-prologue)

## Stables: yard

### stables-arrive

You arrive at the stables. Steam rises off the reindeer's backs into the cold night air.

- [Look at the reindeer](#stables-reindeer)
- [Search the tack room](#stables-tack-room) *(sets: knowsMemo = true)*
- [Talk to the handler](#handler-approach)
- [Climb the ladder to the hayloft](#loft-arrive) *(requires: knowsLoft && !delayed)*
- [Climb the ladder to the hayloft](#loft-arrive-late) *(requires: knowsLoft && delayed)*
- [Head back to the elf village](#elf-approach)

### stables-reindeer

Eight reindeer shuffle in their stalls. One, an old buck with a chipped antler, stares at you and snorts. A bucket of carrots hangs by the gate.

- [Offer the old buck a carrot](#stables-comet) *(sets: hasCarrots = true, knowsLoft = true)*
- [Back to the yard](#stables-arrive)

### stables-comet

The buck crunches the carrot, then trots to the far end of the barn and paws at a rickety ladder leading to a sealed hayloft. A faint knocking comes from above.

- [Climb the ladder](#loft-arrive) *(requires: !delayed)*
- [Climb the ladder](#loft-arrive-late) *(requires: delayed)*
- [Back to the yard](#stables-arrive)

### stables-tack-room

The tack room smells of leather and old peppermint. A noticeboard holds a crumpled memo: *"REINDEER TRANSITION PROGRAMME. Phase 1: Retire the team. Phase 2: Autonomous sleigh drones. Authorised: N. Claus."*

- [Search the rest of the room [Roll D20]](#stables-tack-roll)
- [Back to the yard](#stables-arrive)

### stables-tack-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1: Critical fail](#stables-tack-noise)
- [2-9: Fail](#stables-arrive)
- [10-19: Success](#stables-tack-keys) *(sets: loftKey = true)*
- [20: Critical success](#stables-tack-keys) *(sets: loftKey = true, knowsLoft = true)*

### stables-tack-noise

You knock over a rack of bridles. A gruff voice shouts from the yard: *"Who's in there?"*

- [Step out and face him](#handler-approach)

### stables-tack-keys

Behind a stack of saddle blankets hangs a brass key tagged LOFT, and below it a single red glove with a snowflake monogram. Santa's.

- [Pocket the key and head back to the yard](#stables-arrive)

## Stables: reindeer handlers

### handler-approach

A stocky elf with a badge reading HOLLIS, HEAD HANDLER mucks out a stall with his back to you. *"Stables are closed for inventory."* A younger elf by the water trough looks anywhere but at you.

- [Ask about Santa](#handler-ask-santa)
- [Offer the young elf a carrot](#handler-birch-cracks) *(requires: hasCarrots)*
- [Show them the Transition Programme memo](#handler-confront-memo) *(requires: knowsMemo)*
- [Threaten Hollis](#handler-hostile)
- [Back away](#stables-arrive)

### handler-ask-santa

*"Santa? Haven't seen him in weeks."* Hollis's knuckles whiten on the pitchfork. *"Nothing odd here. Nothing at all."*

- [Mention the sleigh bells on the voicemail](#handler-bells) *(requires: heardBells)*
- [Show them the Transition Programme memo](#handler-confront-memo) *(requires: knowsMemo)*
- [Back off](#handler-approach)

### handler-bells

Hollis freezes. *"Bells?"* Behind him, the young elf drops a bucket. *"The radio... the loft... oh no."* Hollis glares at him.

- [Press them](#handler-confess)

### handler-confront-memo

Hollis stares at the memo. *"Santa wanted to replace the whole team with drones. Thirty centuries of service, and we get a firmware update."* His voice cracks. *"We just wanted to talk to him."*

- [Hear them out](#handler-confess)
- [Tell them you'll have them arrested](#handler-hostile)

### handler-confess

*"We asked him to look at a sick reindeer. Then we locked the loft behind him. We only meant to hold him until he changed his mind."* Hollis swallows. *"Then the heater died in the blizzard and the padlock froze. We can't get it open."*

- [Run to the loft](#loft-arrive) *(sets: handlersConfessed = true, knowsLoft = true)*

### handler-birch-cracks

The young elf, Birch, takes the carrot and whispers. *"Santa's in the hayloft. Hollis said it'd only be a night, but the storm... please don't tell him I told you."*

- [Climb up to the loft](#loft-arrive) *(requires: !delayed · sets: knowsLoft = true)*
- [Climb up to the loft](#loft-arrive-late) *(requires: delayed · sets: knowsLoft = true)*

### handler-hostile

Hollis raises the pitchfork. *"Out."* Other handlers appear from the stalls, silent and unfriendly. By the time you have talked your way past them, a whole hour has slipped by.

- [Slip away to the hayloft](#loft-arrive-late) *(sets: delayed = true, knowsLoft = true)*
- [Back off to the yard](#stables-arrive) *(sets: delayed = true)*

## Stables: hayloft

### loft-arrive

At the top of the ladder is a padlocked hayloft door, white with frost. Behind it, a faint knocking. Cold air seeps through the cracks.

- [Use the loft key](#loft-open) *(requires: loftKey)*
- [Ask Hollis for the key](#loft-open) *(requires: handlersConfessed)*
- [Call out to Santa](#loft-call-out)
- [Break the lock [Roll D20]](#loft-break-roll)

### loft-call-out

A thin voice: *"Is someone there? Tell Hollis I'm not angry. Tell him... it's cold."*

- [Get to work on the lock](#loft-arrive)

### loft-break-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1: Critical fail](#loft-too-late)
- [2-9: Fail](#loft-break-fail)
- [10-19: Success](#loft-open)
- [20: Critical success](#loft-open)

### loft-break-fail

The padlock holds. Beyond the door, the knocking is slower now. You pick up a crowbar.

- [Try again [Roll D20]](#loft-break-roll-2)

### loft-break-roll-2

Roll a D20.

- [1-8: Fail](#loft-too-late)
- [9-19: Success](#loft-open-critical)
- [20: Critical success](#loft-open)

### loft-arrive-late

You clamber up the ladder, bruised and out of breath. The knocking from the loft has stopped.

- [Use the loft key](#loft-open-critical) *(requires: loftKey)*
- [Break the lock [Roll D20]](#loft-break-roll-2)

### loft-open

The door swings open. Santa lies in the straw wrapped in a horse blanket, pale but breathing, whiskers crusted with frost. *"You took your time,"* he croaks, with a ghost of a smile.

- [Help him up](#loft-santa-wakes)

### loft-open-critical

You force the door. Santa lies still in the straw, lips blue, barely breathing.

- [Wrap him in your coat and start CPR [Roll D20]](#loft-cpr-roll)

### loft-cpr-roll

Roll a D20.

- [1-9: Fail](#loft-too-late)
- [10-19: Success](#loft-santa-wakes)
- [20: Critical success](#loft-santa-wakes)

### loft-santa-wakes

Santa coughs and blinks. *"Don't blame the handlers. I was going to replace them with drones. I didn't think. They were scared."* He stares at the rafters. *"Perhaps it's time I hung up the suit."*

- [Help him down to the yard](#loft-yard)

### loft-yard

In the yard, Hollis and Birch drop to their knees. Mrs Claus and Noel come sprinting across the snow. Santa raises a hand. *"Nobody is in trouble. I'm retiring."* He takes off his red hat and holds it out to Noel.

- [Suggest the handlers keep their jobs](#loft-mercy)
- [Say they should answer for it](#loft-justice)

### loft-mercy

Santa smiles. *"The Reindeer Transition Programme is scrapped. Hollis, you're Head of Flight."* Hollis weeps into his pitchfork.

- [Watch Noel put on the hat](#ending-handover-sleigh)

### loft-justice

Santa considers it. *"They locked me in a loft, yes. But I nearly cost them everything. They stay. We'll call it a team-building exercise."*

- [Watch Noel put on the hat](#ending-handover-sleigh)

### loft-too-late

The straw is still. Santa Claus is gone. In the yard, Hollis wails and Birch refuses to look.

- [Carry him down](#loft-carry-down)

### loft-carry-down

Noel and Mrs Claus come running across the snow. Mrs Claus kneels. Noel stands frozen in a suit three sizes too big. *"Christmas,"* he whispers. *"It's in two hours."*

- [Ask Noel to take his father's place](#loft-recruit-noel)

### loft-recruit-noel

*"I can't do this,"* Noel whispers. You hand him the red hat. *"You can. He picked you. Not Jack, not the drones. You."*

- [Watch him take the reins](#ending-cold-case-sleigh)

## Stables: endings

### ending-handover-sleigh

At midnight Noel climbs into the sleigh, the red suit finally fitting. Eight reindeer paw the snow. Santa and Mrs Claus watch from the yard, wrapped in blankets, as the sleigh lifts into the dark.

- [Watch it go](#ending-early-retirement)

### ending-early-retirement

EARLY RETIREMENT. Santa swaps the sleigh for a rocking chair, the reindeer keep their jobs, and Noel does his first run. At the station, your promotion arrives. This time, you believe in Santa.

- [Play again](#intro-prologue)

### ending-cold-case-sleigh

At midnight Noel takes the reins, his coat soaked in snow and grief. The sleigh rises. Below, the elves stand silent in the dark, caps in their hands.

- [Look away](#ending-cold-case)

### ending-cold-case

COLD CASE. Christmas is saved. Nobody asks what happened to Santa, and the file goes in a drawer. You get the promotion. You never quite get warm again.

- [Play again](#intro-prologue)
